title: Integration Forward Briefing — Customer Handoff + Risk Triage (Dec 4, 2029)
content:
Attendees: Priya Nair (SE lead), Ethan Park (ProServices PM), Marisol G. (Field Eng), Omar K. (SRE), Jordan L. (Customer Success)

Purpose: quick weekly sync focused on final handoff items for HelixMed and CobaltEdge integrations, surface risks for cutover windows, and agree next 7-day actions. This is a working note — informal, expect edits.

TL;DR: HelixMed is green for data plane + smoke tests but needs KV cache tuning and an authorization edge case fixed before full cutover. CobaltEdge still needs a credential rotation plan and Dedicated pool sizing confirmed. Both customers requested a midnight cutover window; Ops flagged a potential DB migration overlap on 12/10.

AGENDA:
- Status snapshot (10m)
- Risk triage for cutover windows (15m)
- Action agreement / owners (10m)

STATUS SUMMARY
- HelixMed (onboarding):
  - Current: prep-complete, staged on dedicated-private-vpc-3, smoke tests pass with 95/100 sample prompts.
  - Open tech items: KV cache TTL mismatch observed for long chat sessions (tokens > 8k) causing cache misses and 120-250ms extra tail latency on some traces. Suspected LRU eviction + prefix mismatch.
  - Work done: Marisol deployed a KV cache config with increased shard count and bump to TTL=48h on stage. Initial perf tests show 18% p50 improvement.
  - Blocker: auth header edge-case for multi-tenant proxy — when a client rotates API keys during an in-flight streaming session the proxy returns 401 but runtime doesn't surface proper fallback; reproducible (see JIRA-ONRAMP-324).
  - Cutover ask: HelixMed requested full cutover 12/10 01:00-03:00 PST (they prefer midnight window).
  - Acceptance criteria for cutover: 1) KV cache perf baseline within 10% of stage benchmark; 2) smoke test runset (200 prompts) >= 98% pass; 3) auth edge-case resolved or temporary mitigation (reject-early flag) in place.

- CobaltEdge (onboarding):
  - Current: Integration engineer shadowing client infra team; private-agent deployed but not yet in dedicated pool. End-to-end tests failing intermittently on TLS renegotiation.
  - Work done: Omar traced TLS errors to a client NAT behavior; added connection-retry with jitter to the agent and increased socket keepalive.
  - Blocker: credential rotation plan — client legal requires KMS double-wrap for keys in flight; need Private deployment KMS design sign-off. Ticket: JIRA-OPS-891.
  - Capacity note: c-edge expects sustained 1200 TPS of embedding requests during onboarding tests — need a dedicated pool with burst headroom. Product asked for cost estimate by EOD 12/06.
  - Cutover window: client prefers 12/12 00:30-02:30 PST. Conflicts with HelixMed's DB migration on our side (ops flagged).

RISKS / CONCERNS
- 12/10 internal DB migration window (infra-change) overlaps with HelixMed cutover: ops flagged a risk of transient control-plane latency spikes and delayed rollout toggles. Mitigation options: either move HelixMed cutover earlier (12/09 23:00) or request migration freeze for the small customer cohort. Need Ops decision by 12/06.
- KV cache TTL issue: if not fully resolved, larger-context chats for HelixMed could experience degraded quality/regressions when prefix caching misses occur. Escalate to runtime team if config + shard bump doesn't fully close the gap.
- Dedicated pool sizing for CobaltEdge: underprovisioning could cause test flakiness and a bad onboarding experience. Need clear SLOs and an agreed autoscale burst policy.

TECHNICAL NOTES (quick, non-exhaustive)
- Runtime/Serving: observed that quantized model path (q4) had slightly different tokenization behaviour in edge-case punctuation for HelixMed test set. Not blocking but filed a short eval to ensure parity. (linked artifact: github.com/redwood-inference/onramp-prs/pull/874)
- Routing: set temporary policy to prefer "low-latency" racks for HelixMed until KV performance is stable. This is a manual override in Console rollouts -> route-priority.
- Observability: set these dashboards to watch during cutover: /dashboards/helixmed/route-latency, /dashboards/cobaltedge/error-rate, token-cost-per-request. Create a trace tag "onramp-cutover" to correlate anomalies.

ACTION ITEMS (owner — due — ticket / notes)
- Fix auth edge-case: Marisol — 2029-12-06 — JIRA-ONRAMP-324 (if fix not possible, implement reject-early mitigation and document in runbook).
- Ops decision on DB migration freeze: Omar / Ops — 2029-12-06 — coordinate w/ infra-runbook; if no freeze, propose new HelixMed slot 12/09 23:00.
- Dedicated pool sizing & cost estimate for CobaltEdge: Ethan — 2029-12-06 EOD — include burst headroom and 99p latency target.
- KMS double-wrap design sign-off: Security + Product — 2029-12-07 — JIRA-OPS-891.
- Cutover smoke test harness update (adds 200 prompt set + tokenization parity checks): Jordan — 2029-12-08 — add to CI runner and share results in slack:#onramp-cutovers.
- Add trace tag and dashboards: Omar — 2029-12-09 morning.

NOTES / MEETING ARTIFACTS
- Slack refs: #onramp-helixmed for real-time during cutover; #onramp-ops for DB migration chatter.
- Runbook section references: Onboarding -> HelixMed -> Steps 3-7 (auth fallback) — link: confluence:Onboarding/HelixMed-Runbook
- Smoke test checklist (short):
  1) validate tokenization parity (50 varied prompts)
  2) streaming revert path (simulate token limit + mid-stream key rotation)
  3) KV cache hit rate >= 85% across sample trace set
  4) latency p95 below agreed SLO

OPEN QUESTIONS (to resolve before cutover)
- Can Ops confirm DB migration freeze or shift? (decision by 12/06)
- Will Security sign off on KMS double-wrap by 12/07 or do we need a temporary policy?
- Should HelixMed accept an earlier cutover slot (12/09 23:00) if Ops cannot shift migration?

Notes-to-self: confirm with runtime team if LRU eviction policy can be made per-tenant before HelixMed cutover — if yes, that reduces risk significantly. Also keep small rollback plan (route fallback to "token-constrained-compat" model) ready.

Next sync: 2029-12-06 09:00 PT (standup-lite) — focus on Ops decision and auth fix status.

Appendix: quick logs / pointers:
- Perf traces: s3://onramp-stage/perf/helixmed/2029-12-03/trace-*.json (internal)
- JIRA: JIRA-ONRAMP-324 (auth), JIRA-OPS-891 (KMS)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/onramp-prs/pull/874 (kv config change)

-- End of working notes --
